sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: does a lot of jobs at once. Protein, fibre, and meal utility are why legumes stay valuable. Fuller texture helps real meals. That practical fullness is one reason it can work beyond the numbers. Filling for the calories. Legumes usually earn a lot of practical value from satiety.
